name: protometabolic_network
description: A reusable protometabolic reaction-network module. libRoadRunner/Tellurium SBML rTCA-fragment CSTR (pyruvate carboxylation + lumped autocatalytic rTCA turn + reductive branch) fed the og-01 reduced-carbon products under continuous feed+washout. Emergent: sustained carbon throughput, an autocatalytic motif (gain>1), and a connected reaction network. Requires tellurium + networkx.

feed_pyruvate.description: Pyruvate feed set-point (M) from og-01 reduced carbon

network.doc:
Real libRoadRunner rTCA-fragment CSTR. Reads the upstream feed
(pyruvate + CO2 set-points), advances the genuine SBML ODE network each tick,
and emits the network species (overwrite — roadrunner is the authority) plus
the emergent throughput / autocatalysis / connectivity observables.

_contract.summary: Real libRoadRunner rTCA-fragment CSTR: does a reaction network persist and self-amplify under continuous feed + washout?
_contract.description: An Antimony/SBML reductive-TCA fragment (pyruvate carboxylation, an autocatalytic OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate loop, a reductive branch and washout) integrated every step by the genuine libRoadRunner ODE engine as a continuous-flow stirred reactor. Emits the intermediate concentrations plus the net carbon flux, the autocatalytic gain, and a networkx connectivity flag as overwrite sensors.
assumptions: CSTR continuation: rr.simulate(t, t+dt, 2) each step with feed + first-order washout.
Autocatalysis via OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate.

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
